source:
## ERB templates: text runs interleaved with <% %> action tags —
## expression (<%=), code (<%), and comment (<%#) forms. The pragmatic
## subset keeps % out of code bodies (a literal % needs the tag's
## closing to be visible).
grammar Erb version "1.0.0" edition "v2" {
  ## anything but "<": a text run.
  tchar = %x01-3B / %x3D-10FFFF
  text = 1*tchar
  ## anything but "%": a code body.
  cchar = %x01-24 / %x26-10FFFF
  ## comment and code bodies may be empty; an expression may not.
  comment_tag = "<%" "#" *cchar "%>"
  code_tag = "<%" *cchar "%>"
  expr_tag = "<%" "=" 1*cchar "%>"
  tag = comment_tag / expr_tag / code_tag
  template = *( text / tag )

  entry main: template

  test {
    accept "plain text"
    accept "<%= name %>"
    accept "Hello <%= user.name %>!"
    accept "<% if x %>yes<% else %>no<% end %>"
    accept "<%# a comment %>"
    reject "<% unterminated"
    reject "text <%"
  }
}
